claim_boundary: This method-specific execution lock evaluates the independently source-calibrated repeated-action robust scale rule on all thirteen publicly materializable recordings from PokeFlex's official validation list. All thirteen target outcomes were opened previously under a different fixed-scale protocol, so this evaluation is retrospective and cannot support a prospective-confirmation claim. Five officially listed validation takes are absent from the public archive and receive no replacements. The released checkpoint and the reproduced global 0.125 arm are the paired references. Falling numerically below the published 6.498 mm value on this thirteen-take subset is contextual evidence only and is not a direct comparison with the published eighteen-object aggregate.

custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.retry_policy: no replacement; technical failures and exact fallbacks remain in the registered cohort
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the registered official evaluator
custody.target_mesh_access_before_barrier: historically opened under a prior protocol; this rerun forbids target-mesh access until all new prediction seals pass
custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule

evaluation.aggregation: equal scored frames over the 13 publicly materializable official validation takes; all results are retrospective for this scale rule
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and valid fraction; never substitute a voxel or repaired-mesh surrogate
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.jaccard_role: non-gating reproducibility diagnostic because the released target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric
evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates

forbidden: reading target meshes during this rerun before all thirteen new prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or otherwise imputing a required actuator pose
changing the repeated-action multiplier map, global fallbacks, support radius, metric, aggregation, or gates after this lock
replacing any of the five unavailable official takes or any technically failed public-subset take
representing any of the thirteen takes as prospectively untouched for this scale rule
substituting a repaired-mesh or voxel Jaccard for the registered public-mesh diagnostic
claiming reproduction of or direct comparison with the published eighteen-object aggregate
claiming that a numerically lower public-subset score establishes full-split state of the art
touching any held-v8 artifact or process

method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f
